description: Railway stations/stops and real-time departures in the Brussels-Capital Region is a dataset listed in Open Data | Ville de Bruxelles - Stad Brussel - City of Brussels, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by City of Brussels/Data Management. Railway stations/stops and real-time departures in the Brussels-Capital Region Main source: Source of the field containing the link to real-time departures: More info: SNCB/NMBS website: iRail website: Belgian public transport Open Data portal: Infrabel Open Data portal:. Coverage: City of Brussels. The portal files it under Mobility. Its keywords are station, train, SNCB, NMBS, timetable, stop. The portal shows 33 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-brussels-be-portal.
